native.tip: Kita bilang “terima kasih sebelumnya”, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai in advance, bukan before.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Thanks before.” 😅 Di akhir email, tulis in advance: “Thanks in advance.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “in advance”. Tulis satu email pendek dan akhiri dengan “Thanks in advance.” Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “terima kasih sebelumnya”, but English uses in advance, not before.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Thanks before.” 😅 At the end of an email, write in advance: “Thanks in advance.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
